description: Build an actor stat-change scene command for insertion via insert_event_commands: hp (311), mp (312), state (313), recover_all (314), exp (315), or level (316). Targets a fixed actor (0 = whole party) or a variable. hp/mp/exp/level take an increase/decrease `operand` (constant or variable); state takes add/remove + `stateId`; recover_all takes nothing extra. Read-only: returns { command }.

allowKnockout.description: hp: allow the change to reduce HP to 0/death (default false)

type.description: constant amount or a variable value

variableId.description: variable: the variable id to read

showLevelUp.description: exp/level: show the level-up message (default false)

stateOperation.description: state: add or remove the state

target.description: Which actor(s) the change applies to

actorId.description: fixed: the actor id (0 = entire party)

type.description: fixed actor id (0 = whole party) or a variable

variableId.description: variable: the variable id holding the actor id

name: build_change_actor
